properties.evidence: The better-powered explanation, and today is a further data point for it — arguably the cleanest available test of the confound this node names about itself. It warns that `where-am-i`'s dominance may be hook-presence OR intrinsic usefulness, since the two are confounded. `find_tools` separates them: it is intrinsically useful for exactly the job this session had, it is NOT named in the SessionStart hook, and it was not called once in a day spent changing the very surface it indexes. Hook-named tools were used throughout the same session. One session, and the session is the instrument, so this is offered as a data point rather than as the discriminating experiment that node asks for.
